note: R5 (Security, raised during the kill-daily review): a LIVE, PRE-EXISTING renown faucet in the DEPLOYED 2026-08-30-bounty-kill-credit.sql — NOT introduced by 2026-09-01. hr_credit_kills (bounty branch) writes stat/ev:kill_any and stat/ev:kill_monster:<id>, and hr_renown_of SCORES both (0.05/kill; 5/kill for is_boss ids). STRUCTURAL ROOT: hr_bounty_kills reads stat/ev:kill_monster:<target>, the SAME row the bestiary displays and renown scores, so moving renown is a side effect of making a bounty completable. MEASURED: all 108 monsters are bounty-eligible and the 14 bosses are tier 6; at damage level 99 max_hit_ceil is 319, so a 520-HP dragon needs 2 swings -> min_kill 1200ms -> 65 boss kills/min = 19,500 renown/hr, ~8.5x honest, with no gear, no risk and no combat. Re-accepting is NOT needed — one bounty held indefinitely sustains it (re-accepting is worse for the attacker: it resets accepted_at so the cap restarts at 0). WHAT THE SCORE BUYS: the renown BOARD is not the exposure (removed from leaderboard_ranked by 2026-08-18 as no_server_source); the consumers are hr_claim_rank (1,603,000 gold + 925 gems per character across serf..highking; x6 slots = 9,618,000 gold + 5,550 gems; gold feeds the LIVE wealth board and is market purchasing power, gems are premium) and hr_perks_of renownAllXp (+0.04 all-skill XP, feeding the LIVE total_level/combat_level boards). ~6.2h scripted vs ~53h honest to highking. THE FIX (design option C of three, the two rejected recorded in docs/design/renown-kill-faucet.md): DISCOUNT the client-credited portion inside the SCORE rather than capping the writes — a ceiling two orders above the honest rate is a fuse, not a control. hr_credit_kills additionally records ev:kill_credited:<target> and ev:kill_credited_any by the SAME v_applied; hr_renown_of scores greatest(0, counter - credited), per-monster for the boss term (an aggregate discount would let credits on a NON-boss target erase honest boss renown). Client credit therefore contributes EXACTLY ZERO renown. ASYMMETRY BY DESIGN: hr_credit_kills__ungated is PATCHED programmatically at a guarded exactly-once anchor (the combat-style idiom) because it is a WRITE path with money downstream that this file did not author — restating it is how a hotfix gets silently reverted; hr_renown_of is RESTATED because it is stable, writes nothing, is ~60 lines of pure arithmetic, is hr_engine-only, and changes in two terms in its middle. §0b pins the live hr_renown_of body first (md5 beed1fb6221211794ee5853dfb111062, normalised length 2931, MEASURED on BOTH production and a full PGlite replay and found byte-identical) with [[:space:]]+ normalisation, NOT ‘s+’ (the two runtimes disagree on backslash classes under standard_conforming_strings — measured). THIS FILE BECOMES hr_renown_of’s NEW LAST TOUCHER (it had exactly one before, 2026-08-20-renown.sql, and is on no derivation chain); it takes over NO role for hr_credit_kills, which it only patches. ⚠ APPLY ORDER: DEPENDS ON 2026-09-01-kill-daily-credit.sql — §1’s anchor lives in the body THAT file installs, and §0 fails closed BY NAME if it is absent. Ship kill-daily FIRST, faucet SECOND. NO BACKFILL: the credited counters start at zero so renown is UNCHANGED for every existing character at apply time (nobody loses a rank or a perk), and renown already accrued from credited kills since 2026-08-30 is NOT clawed back — the beta is wiped at cutover and hr_claim_rank’s high-water keeps a claimed rank claimed. STATED COST: renown stops scoring attended kills the client credited, a deliberate under-count returning renown to its pre-2026-08-30 position. Server-only: no edge redeploy, no client change, no grant widened, no client call form moved. §3 PROVES on apply, in an HR822-rolled-back subtransaction: the HONEST CONTROL first (a 100-kill settle moves renown by exactly 505, so the fix cannot degenerate into renown-always-0), then the faucet closed (a real accepted bounty + a real hr_credit_kills of 400 on a real is_boss target moves renown by 0, with a fixture-degenerate guard proving the credit actually applied), sustained spam over five re-opened windows still 0, a settle AFTER the credits still scoring (the discount subtracts, it does not latch), the bestiary row still moving and the bounty turn-in still paying. SECURITY PRE-BUILD CONDITIONS FOLDED IN: (1) the two-migration coupling is PINNED, not described — §0a pins TWO hashes, c_expect (the body 2026-09-01 installs, literally that file's own c_self, so the two cannot drift apart about what 'the kill-daily body' means) and c_applied (this file's own output, so a re-apply is a no-op); anything else raises, and applying this file WITHOUT kill-daily fails closed BY NAME with the remedy (verified by booting the chain without it and executing this file). A substring probe was rejected as insufficient because the identical idiom in 2026-09-01 §0b was PROVEN to wave through a hotfix applied on top. (2) RETROACTIVITY is stated rather than implied: forward-only; credited kills since 2026-08-30 keep scoring forever; there is NO backfill source (hr_kill_credit_log is retained two days); already-claimed ranks are unrecoverable (hr_claim_rank consumes a once-per-rank guard and holds a greatest() high-water, so up to 1,603,000 gold + 925 gems per character may already be banked); renownAllXp self-corrects for future credits only. ⚠ AND THE HIGH-WATER IS WORSE THAN 'ranks already taken': an inflated renown_high is also a STANDING CLAIM on every rank BELOW it, because the ratchet does not decay — a score reached once by the faucet keeps every cheaper rank claimable indefinitely, long after this fix stops the score rising that way. Moot today (live max renown_high is 773, below squire's 900), but that is an observation about today's data and not a property, so the trigger is recorded rather than the reassurance. The answer is the BETA WIPE, written down as the whole justification with the explicit trigger that if the wipe is cancelled or deferred past this fix THAT PARAGRAPH must be re-opened, because the correct action becomes a renown recompute plus a rank-claim audit and neither exists. (3) THE ORDERING INVARIANT ev:kill_credited:<id> <= bestiary(<id>) is asserted (the bestiary is written absolutely via greatest, the counter additively). ⚠ The invariant alone proved TOO WEAK to catch its own mutation — honest kills in the bestiary row absorb the overshoot so no inversion appears — so the property that actually holds the line is a SIGNED EQUALITY: a THROTTLED credit must move renown by EXACTLY 0. Above 0 the faucet is open; BELOW 0 the discount is eating renown the player earned honestly, which every 'did not rise' check passes straight over. Asserted at both layers (GATE(c5b) and guard R8); the mutation reads -550. (4) THE CREDITED KEYS CAN NEVER BE PRUNED — period_key='' is the permanent population and hr_progress_prune deletes only period_key <> ''. If a credited row could be swept while the row it discounts survives, the discount fails OPEN and the faucet re-opens on a timer with nothing looking broken. ⚠ THE FIRST PROOF OF THIS WAS VACUOUS (Security C1, caught in the full pass): GATE(c6)/R9 ran the prune at interval '0 seconds' on rows created microseconds earlier, but hr_progress_prune floors its age at greatest(interval '7 days', p_older), so it deleted NOTHING and the assertion passed identically whether the rows were permanent or periodic. Measured: fresh → 0 deleted; backdated 400 days → the periodic control deleted and the credited rows survive. The PROPERTY was true, the PROOF was not testing it. A 'nothing was deleted' assertion is evidence ONLY when something else WAS, so both layers now plant a period_key <> '' CONTROL that must die, age every probe row past the floor, and FAIL THE FIXTURE LOUDLY if the prune reports zero deletions; mutation prune_probe_not_aged restores the vacuous shape and must read RED (it does). (5) READ COST measured, because hr_renown_of is on hr_perks_of's path which the accrual engine calls every settle and the op-count analysis covers WRITES only: both added lookups supply player_progress' complete PRIMARY KEY (one probe for the kill term, one per bestiary row (<=108) for the boss term — no new scan, no new sort). MEASURED ON PRODUCTION against a full bestiary: 2.67 ms/call, a DELTA of +0.44 ms over the undiscounted body (~20% of an already-cheap read, once per ~90s settle). The guard's own ~3 ms figure is a PGlite PROXY, labelled as such in its output, and exists to catch a plan collapsed into a scan per bestiary row (orders of magnitude) rather than to benchmark. TESTS: tests/renown-kill-faucet.mjs — R1 honest control (a settle scores exactly 505), R2 faucet closed with a fixture-degenerate guard, R3 sustained spam, R4 subtract-not-latch, R5 the bounty turn-in still pays, R6 per-monster, R7 read cost, R8 throttled signed equality + the invariant, R9 unprunable (with its own anti-vacuity fixture checks); 11 mutations ALL CAUGHT, three with the migration's own gate short-circuited so the guard alone must see them. Security: MONEY + RANKED surface — REQUIRES A FULL SECURITY PASS before apply.
